xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #2858 — core:validate must honor dispatcher cwd and not walk node_modules

plan.title: bug(render): core:validate capture walks process.cwd()/node_modules (hangs task check)

narratives.Description: cmdCoreValidate always walks collectMarkdownFiles(".") so runFrameworkCommand with a scoped frameworkRoot still validates process.cwd(). Under task check that walks the monorepo plus .deft-scratch worktree node_modules and times out at 120s, blocking release.
narratives.Overview: Pass the dispatcher cwd into the inline core:validate path; harden collectMarkdownFiles to skip node_modules and .deft-scratch; keep the temp-root regression test under a short timeout; CHANGELOG cites #2858.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) In packages/core/src/render/framework-commands.ts, change cmdCoreValidate / collectMarkdownFiles to accept an explicit root (default "." only when intentional). 2) Update invokeEntrypoint inline TS_INLINE handlers so framework_commands:_cmd_core_validate receives the resolved cwd argument (no ambient chdir). 3) Exclude node_modules, .deft-scratch, and similar junk from collectMarkdownFiles. 4) Ensure packages/core/src/render/framework-commands-branches.test.ts cmdCoreValidate succeeds with capture passes quickly against a temp root. 5) Verify with pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/render/framework-commands-branches.test.ts and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] citing #2858.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer running task check before a release, I want core:validate to honor the scoped framework root and finish quickly, so that Vitest does not hang walking worktree node_modules.

items.title: Given a temp frameworkRoot, when core:validate runs with capture, then only that tree is walked.

narrative.Acceptance: Given runFrameworkCommand("core:validate", [], { capture: true, frameworkRoot: temp, projectRoot: temp }) with one sample.md in temp, when the command runs, then it exits 0 quickly and stdout reports that single-file validation without walking the repo node_modules.

items.title: Given collectMarkdownFiles on a large checkout, when junk dirs exist, then they are skipped.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a tree containing node_modules and .deft-scratch, when collectMarkdownFiles runs, then those directories are not descended into.

items.title: Given the branch coverage test, when vitest runs it, then it passes under a short timeout.

narrative.Acceptance: Given packages/core/src/render/framework-commands-branches.test.ts, when pnpm exec vitest run that file, then cmdCoreValidate succeeds with capture passes without a 120s timeout.

items.title: Given the fix lands, when CHANGELOG is updated, then #2858 is cited.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the render fix, when the PR opens, then CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #2858.

references.title: Issue #2858: bug(render) core:validate capture walks process.cwd()/node_modules
